title: 30-A Beach Properties: 91 Siasconset in Gulf Front & Views – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: 30-A Beach Properties: 91 Siasconset in Gulf Front & Views.
description_expanded:
30a Beach Properties presents 91 Siasconset Ln. Brand new to rental for August 2026 with Gulf Views. Comfortable seating with a big screen TV to relax. Sights and sounds from this Main Street setting in the heart of the Rosemary Beach village. 3 Large balconies offer several areas to relax and take in the Gulf air. A wonderfully sophisticated vacation awaits at the 91 Siasconset!

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Features:

Gulf views

3rd Floor master Suite with Gulf Views and Private Balcony

2nd Floor Open Living - Kitchen - Dining

1st Floor Bunk room with 4 Queen Bunks and 2nd Living/TV room\

Coffee Bar with Keurig and Drip Machines

4 Bikes included

10 Beach Towels Included

Parking for up to 2 cars in the Driveway

Coffee bar with Keurig and Drip Machines

ABOUT PROMINENCE COMMUNITY - WATERSOUND, FL

Prominence on 30A is one of the most popular communities along Scenic Highway 30A, offering incredible amenities, open green spaces, and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Perfectly located near 30A favorites and the area’s sugar-white beaches, Prominence features a charming town center and two resort-style pools.

At the heart of it all, The Big Chill is a lively gathering place featuring an outdoor 25-foot LED theater screen for concerts, movie nights, and sporting events, as well as boutique shops, family-friendly activities, and excellent dining options.

Centrally situated between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east, Prominence places you right in the middle of everything that makes 30A special.

COMMUNITY & THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES

• Two resort-style zero-entry pools – perfect for all ages

• Walking distance to The Big Chill – dining, shops, and nightly entertainment

• Luke Bryan’s cigar and gastro pub – a favorite local hangout

• Family movie nights and live sports on the outdoor big screen

• Onsite ice machine and barbecue grilling areas

• Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seaside

Beach access for all Prominence homes is available through South Walton public beach access points. Most guests use Deer Lake State Park or other nearby public accesses along 30A. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access through Watersound Club and do not include access to Watersound private club facilities.
